candidates.failure_scenario: README 'Testing locally': compose up, round 1 finds no home-override.md, writes the chain home and sleeps 3600 s; the operator then places home-override.md and checks http://127.0.0.1/, which keeps the old page for up to an hour (base: 60 s). Same pacing on a first start whose blog query fails (DNS not up yet in a fresh compose): home.md is written without the posts, so the homepage shows the 'Latest from the blog' heading with only the button under it for an hour, and every later failure is retried hourly. The hour buys nothing the base paid for: rounds with no change already end at cmp without a write, and gnoweb no longer restarts.
